name: Coffre Fort
description: Stores encrypted per-'safe' secrets that are unlocked with a user password or external provider.
project_description:
Coffre-fort is an open source project , to help secure all types of highly confidential information from being leaked before the right time.

 Features:

 - All private data are encrypted before being saved in database.

- Data encryptions is protected by user provided password. so there is no way to unlock the coffre-fort and view private data.

- Once unlocked, you can view all private data.

- If locked, replacement data values will be used instead of the secret values.

- All private data names are exposed as tokens , so they can be used on contents , blocks, configurations ..

- Password protection can be modified or replaced by any different secret provider.
